overview: The Medford Park Commission reviewed several park permit and field use requests for upcoming spring and summer activities. The commission approved several permits, tabled others pending additional information or scheduling, and tabled a memorial plaque proposal for Carr Park.

items.title: USTA League Dates and Memorandum of Understanding
items.summary: Approved a makeup date of June 8 at Playstead Park, while a proposed memorandum of understanding and summer dates were delayed to allow the commission to review the agreement and meet again in May.

items.title: Boston Ultimate Disc Life Permit
items.summary: Approved use of Harris Park and Tufts Park for ultimate frisbee on specified dates from May through August, contingent on fee payment and a certificate of insurance.

items.title: School and Youth Field Permits
items.summary: Approved St. Raphael School's field day at Playstead Park and provisionally approved a Missituk School PTO event and field day contingent on insurance and baseball scheduling, while tabling another youth organization's request due to lack of representation.

items.title: United India Association of New England Permit
items.summary: Tabled the permit application to the next meeting due to the lack of an applicant representative.

items.title: Winky Face Ultimate Frisbee Permit
items.summary: Held the application for Barry Park pending confirmation of Medford Youth Baseball's schedule.

items.title: Memorial Park Summer Permit
items.summary: Approved a recurring summer league permit request for Memorial Park on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.

items.title: Birthday Party at Playstead Park
items.summary: Approved a permit for a birthday party on the lower field at Playstead Park on April 23, contingent on receiving a certificate of insurance naming the city as an additional insured from the NERF vendor.

items.title: Memorial Plaque Request for Carr Park
items.summary: Tabled a request from Sue Fowler-Finn to place a memorial plaque at Carr Park honoring a deceased local pickleball player until ground is broken on the new courts and the full commission is present.
